name: Enthusiastic_1
short_caption: The robot pulls both hands to its chest in an enthusiastic, self-affirming gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing posture and quickly pulls both elbows back and brings its hands towards its chest, bending its head slightly forward in a moment of eager anticipation or excitement. After a brief hold in this energized posture, the robot smoothly extends both arms downward, returning its head and hands to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: None. The movement is compact and stays close to the robot's main frame.
